name: Article 5, § 1, point b – 136
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Union Civil Protection Mechanism and Union support for health emergency preparedness and response, and repealing Decision No 1313/2013/EU (Union Civil Protection Mechanism)
part_text: (b) develop and maintain arrangements to clarify roles and responsibilities to ensure operational cooperation of civilian and military capacities for preparing and responding to disasters and crises within the Union. Those arrangements shall include Union wide scenarios and shall form the basis of Union level joint training and exercises. They shall also contribute to the development and dissemination of standard operating procedures and best practices, and of mechanisms for effective cooperation and communication before and during crisis situations, emphasizing societal preparedness and strengthening the population's resilience to crises;
